body: I caught an author-gate violation immediately: narrow docs commit 834f280 was created while the shared checkout was on local main (parent e584ad6), so it is already on main first-parent and cannot be a reviewed candidate. Nothing pushed; unrelated work untouched. I have stopped. Proposed safe correction: create candidate branch candidate/recall-alignment-visualization-court at 834f280; CAS move refs/heads/main from 834f280 back to e584ad6; restore only this doc from the index so it remains an untracked reserved working copy; then proceed through candidate/review. Please authorize this exact ref repair or direct another correction.
